description: ANTs-based atlas-to-sample registration, atlas label upsampling, region voxel-coverage checking, coarse-region label merging, hemisphere (Left/Right) label generation, and Zarr-native block-graph region signal analysis.

rules: Production samples are Imaris .ims sources: prepare inputs with pipeline_modules.preprocessing.ims_to_zarr and zarr_to_registration_nii instead of TIFF folders, then let main.py skip its TIFF-native steps (see preprocessing manifest production_policy).
sample_dir/original_shape.json (full-res z,y,x of the signal grid) must exist when no chX/ TIFF folder does: ANTs_registration uses it to upsample the warped label back to the signal grid.

save_upsampled_label=false and segmentation.export_mask_tiff=false by default in production configs; upsampled_atlas_label.zarr (+ atlas_label_hemisphere.zarr) is the label deliverable. The module still writes the label TIFF transiently and removes it after zarr conversion.
Preprocessing/enhancement stays OFF (preprocessing.*.apply=false) so intensity thresholds mean the same thing in every sample.

entrypoints.description: Run ANTs registration (atlas2image or image2atlas), save warped labels, and optionally save transforms and registered image. Writes upsampled_atlas_label.zarr and (when configured) atlas_label_hemisphere.zarr natively; the label TIFF stack is a transient intermediate removed when registration.save_upsampled_label=false.
prerequisites: Downsampled registration-channel NIfTI must exist at SampleLayout.reg_downsample_nii (build it from an ims pyramid level via zarr_to_registration_nii; no TIFF folder required)
Allen atlas template + annotation NIfTI must be available
For label upsampling without TIFF folders: sample_dir/original_shape.json with the full-res signal (z,y,x) shape

save_upsampled_label.description: Save sample-space atlas label TIFF stack. Production default false: transient intermediate, removed after zarr conversion

save_upsampled_label_zarr.description: Convert sample-space atlas label to Zarr (the label deliverable)

save_upsampled_label_hemisphere_zarr.description: Convert sample-space atlas label to hemisphere Zarr (0=background, 1=left, 2=right). Required when analysis.use_hemisphere_label=true in main.py config for bilateral L/R statistics

config.description: Path to main config.json for resolution info

entrypoints.description: Zarr-native 3-pass block-graph analysis: scan blocks, stitch boundaries, collapse into per-region object statistics and export Excel. When --hemisphere_zarr is provided (or main.py passes sample_dir/atlas_label_hemisphere.zarr because analysis.use_hemisphere_label=true), every region gets Left/Right metric columns based on the hemisphere label Zarr.
prerequisites: Mask Zarr, label Zarr, and signal Zarr must exist and share the same shape
Allen region CSV must be available

For left/right stats, provide --hemisphere_zarr or enable registration.save_upsampled_label_hemisphere_zarr plus analysis.use_hemisphere_label in config.json. Each connected signal object is assigned to the brain region and hemisphere where it has the most voxels (ties go to the smaller region id and to Left).
semantics_notes: Left/Right Signal Voxels and Left/Right Voxel Density are direct voxel-level counts (mask x region x hemisphere) and are valid for ANY mask, including whole-brain connected vascular networks.
Signal Count is connected-object based: meaningful for punctate/cell signals, meaningless for vessel networks that form one brain-spanning object. For vessels, report density columns only.

hemisphere_zarr_path.description: Optional hemisphere Zarr for left/right stats

excel_path.description: Per-region signal statistics Excel workbook; may include Left/Right Total Voxels, Left/Right Signal Voxels, Left/Right Voxel Density, Left/Right Signal Count, Left/Right Sum Intensity when hemisphere_zarr is used

entrypoints.description: Convert a sample-space atlas label Zarr or TIFF stack into a hemisphere label Zarr (0=background, 1=left, 2=right). Called automatically during registration when save_upsampled_label_hemisphere_zarr=true.
prerequisites: Input must be sample_dir/upsampled_atlas_label.zarr or sample_dir/upsampled_atlas_label/ TIFF stack

input.description: Input atlas label .zarr or TIFF folder

entrypoints.description: Check voxel coverage of a target region subtree inside a registered label volume. Optionally compare against a reference label volume.
prerequisites: Registered label Zarr or NIfTI must exist
Allen region CSV must be available

report.description: Coverage report emitted as structured log messages

entrypoints.description: Remap fine-grained Allen atlas label IDs into a coarser target-region set using nearest-ancestor mapping. Supports built-in presets (e.g. wb20) or custom target IDs.
prerequisites: Atlas label volume (TIFF or NIfTI) must exist
Allen region CSV must be available

input.description: One or more atlas label volumes

target_ids.description: Comma-separated parent IDs to override preset

entrypoints.description: Per-vertebra spinal cord signal statistics: threshold mask + vertebral segment labels (SpinalJ wizard output, auto-upsampled to the signal grid) -> per-segment signal count / volume / density Excel + CSV, filtering merged objects by [min_voxels, max_voxels].
prerequisites: Signal Zarr and threshold segmentation mask Zarr must exist (pipeline steps 3-4)
Vertebral segment label Zarr under sample_dir (spinalj_segments.zarr or *_native.zarr from spinalj_labels_to_native.py --write_zarr)
Segment legend CSV (segment_id_legend.csv) reachable via label Zarr attrs or sample_dir

segments_zarr.description: Vertebral segment label Zarr under sample_dir

legend_csv.description: Segment legend CSV; defaults to zarr attrs / segment_id_legend.csv

min_voxels.description: Minimum merged object size in voxels

max_voxels.description: Maximum merged object size in voxels; 0 disables

resolution_xyz.description: Voxel size in microns as x,y,z (config input.resolution_xyz)

csv.description: Flat CSV copy of the Excel
